light.title: Song library
light.summary: The library grouped by artist. Every row carries its chord progression and tags.

light.title: Link import
light.summary: Add Song opens with the import panel ready for a web link.

light.title: Imported song draft
light.summary: A stubbed Genius page fills the title, artist and lyrics without using the live network.

light.title: Chord keyboard
light.summary: The chord field brings up the purpose-built piano keyboard for entering progressions.

light.title: Shuffle
light.summary: Shuffle picks a song from the library and opens it immediately.

light.title: Search
light.summary: Searching for “Never gonna give”. Search covers titles, artists and tags, and the library narrows as the query is typed.

light.title: Matching songs
light.summary: The detail view surfaces songs that use the same normalized chord progression.

light.title: Matching song selected
light.summary: Selecting Let It Be moves straight into it, without returning to the library.

light.title: Next song
light.summary: The forward control chooses another song while keeping the player controls in place.

light.title: Song opens
light.summary: Morning Light opens: the chord chart in the body, the progression and the playback controls pinned to the bottom bar.

light.title: Transpose control
light.summary: Tapping the chord capsules opens the transpose stepper.

light.title: Transposed up a semitone
light.summary: One semitone up. The whole chart follows — the capsules, the chords beside each section marker and the chords above the words — while the words stay put and every chord keeps the column it was written in.

light.title: Autoscroll starts
light.summary: Play is pressed. The chart starts moving on its own and the button becomes pause.

light.title: Speed control
light.summary: The speed dial opens over the running scroll, without interrupting it.

light.title: Speed raised to maximum
light.summary: The slider is dragged from the middle to the top and the chart picks up pace.

light.title: Hands-free autoscroll
light.summary: The longest shot in the cut. Nothing is touched: the chart keeps travelling by itself, hands free. This is what the video exists to show.
